paragraphs.text:
ATHENS AIRPORT
At the tiny airport, three aircraft sit beside the 
airstrip. A Douglas M2 mail plane, ten years old 
and looking it, rests alone. A Ford TN-Motor waits 
in front of an open hangar. A Fokker T-2, a strange 
bird with its snub nose, has a mechanic working on it. You notice 
a single bystander who seems to watch you intently.
Inquiries at the office reveal that the TN-Motor makes regular 
flights to Cairo. It leaves at 8am daily. If you buy a ticket, go to 
99 when the flight is due to take off. 
The mail plane is not delivering mail anymore. The pilot, 
Jacques Risee, sits in the tiny bar. If you wish to see him, go to 57.
The clerk says that the Fokker is unavailable, but if you want 
to look it over, go to 43. If you are done here, go to any Athens 
Location.
(Athens Location)
